location_description: Buffalo Grove, officially the Village of Buffalo Grove, is a village in Lake and Cook County, Illinois. A suburb of Chicago, it lies about 30 miles (50 km) northwest of Downtown Chicago.  As of the 2020 Census, Buffalo Grove has a population of 43,212.
